parse_fasta: parse a FASTA string and return a tuple of amino acid sequences and descriptions
parse_stockholm: parse a Stockholm format alignment string and return an MSA object with sequences and deletion matrix
parse_a3m: parse an A3M format alignment string and return an MSA object with sequences and deletion matrix
convert_stockholm_to_a3m: convert a Stockholm format MSA string to A3M format with optional sequence truncation
parse_hhr: parse an HHR file string and return a list of TemplateHit objects with alignment details
